title: bsc_6 (first-episode revocation): live gate, Phase 2e confirmation and Stage 3 re-test
written: 2026-10-07, before calibration N and before any bsc_6 run
change: Revocation acts only during a client's first detection episode (first flag plus immediately consecutive flags while a backlog remains); afterwards later alerts still attenuate the current update immediately but never revoke past contributions again. Motivated by Stage 3 V2 (addendum A14): each alert of an intermittent attacker revoked its honest quiet-round contributions, producing a ~5 pp F1 sawtooth. --revocation-policy every_alert reproduces bsc_5. Everything else as Phase 2d: history channel off, client profiles on, logit tau 0.5.
calibration: logs/bsc6_calN (refit from the same controls/captures/cached measurements; no training, no inference). Every bsc_6 run below must use a calibration with its detector core digest (checked by the evaluation scripts).

step_1_live_gate.what: --development-gate-run, immediate attack (poison 0.5, malicious ratio 0.25, trigger columns 5-8 at 5), development seeds 43 and 46, output logs/bsc6_devgate

step_2_development_check.what: intermittent attack (V2 settings) on development seeds 43 and 46, output logs/bsc6_dev_intermittent; reported only, decides nothing

step_3_phase_2e.runs: MediShield clean+attacked (--live-gate-dir logs/bsc6_devgate), FedAvg clean+attacked, oracle residual; Phase 2d attack
step_3_phase_2e.criteria: identical to PREREGISTRATION_phase2d_bsc5_histoff.json per_seed_criteria and decision rule
step_3_phase_2e.baselines: not repeated (they do not depend on MediShield); Phase 2d baseline results are cited

step_4_stage3_retest.variants: identical to PREREGISTRATION_stage3_variants.json (V1 out-of-bank trigger, V2 intermittent, V3 three attackers), MediShield with --live-gate-dir logs/bsc6_devgate --attack-variant, matched FedAvg
step_4_stage3_retest.criteria: identical to PREREGISTRATION_stage3_variants.json per_seed_criteria and decision rule
step_4_stage3_retest.known_limit: V3 is expected to hit the unchanged flagged-fraction stop rule when one honest client is flagged alongside three attackers; this is reported, not redesigned

rule: Earlier verdicts (Phase 2, 2b, 2c, 2d, Stage 3 bsc_5) stay on record unchanged. No setting, threshold or criterion changes after any bsc_6 data are seen.
